claim_scope: Original generic tide-dominated delta geological-process analog informed by Fly River satellite morphology and published primary tidal-channel research. Not a Fly DEM, measured site, period-specific ecosystem, hydrodynamic simulation or exact tidal range. Nominal10x12km landscape footprint and180m cut-tile depth are illustrative art choices, not measured topography. Water is static opaque simplified solid volume; low islands and widening connected mouths diagnose the form. No vegetation inferred from modern reference.
